name: Ester
description: A carbonyl carbon joined to an oxygen that carries another carbon — the linkage left behind when an acid meets an alcohol.

name: Lactone
description: An ester whose linkage is closed inside a ring instead of joining two open chains.

name: Macrolactone
description: A lactone whose ring runs to twelve atoms or more — the large-ring esters.

name: Macrocyclic ketone
description: A ketone whose carbonyl sits inside a ring of twelve atoms or more — the large-ring ketones.

name: Macrocyclic ring
description: Any ring of twelve atoms or more, whatever else the molecule carries.

name: Ketone
description: A carbonyl carbon with a carbon on either side — no hydrogen there, which is what separates it from an aldehyde.

name: Aldehyde
description: A carbonyl carbon carrying one hydrogen and one carbon: the end of a chain rather than the middle of one.

name: Alcohol
description: A hydroxyl group on a saturated carbon.
